relevance.description: Minimum relevance score before relevance modifiers and merchandising rules. Expected range is 0 (everything matches) through 100 (exact matches). Null means no override at this level.

adjusted.description: Minimum adjusted score after relevance modifiers and merchandising rules. Expected range is 0 through 100. Null means no override at this level.

description: Configured relevance score thresholds for Retail Media promotion eligibility.
